title: Fever dream
body:
. . .

Have you ever gotten sick and had an awful fever dream? The barely comprehensible, migraine-inducing type, where you can't tell what's real and what isn't...

Your mind, already fighting off whatever's attacking you, forgets to keep restraints in place, and your nightmares unlock their full potential...

![image: Fever dream](media/1453866345384116227.png)

. . .

I think everyone has experienced that.

![image: Fever dream](media/1453866771974193355.png)

If you can fight it off, you might find just what you need to hang on a little longer.

![image: Fever dream](media/1453867430215418082.png)

![audio: Fever dream](media/1453868615806750914.mp3)

You may be wondering whose fever dream this is. The answer: it's not yours.
